caption: A cloth is draped over a wall mirror, and the reflection of the room disappears behind the cloth.

sa.check: A wall mirror reflects the room.
A cloth is draped over it.
The reflection disappears behind the cloth.
The cloth goes on first and the reflection disappears with it.

pc.expect: The reflected room is visible until the cloth covers the glass and is gone wherever the cloth hangs.
pc.fail: The reflection shows through the cloth; or it vanishes before the cloth arrives; or it stays visible on covered glass.

pc.expect: The reflection would return when the cloth is pulled off, and the real room is unchanged.
pc.fail: The room changes while covered; or the mirror vanishes; or a reflection appears on the cloth itself.

pc.expect: The cloth hangs down over the mirror.
pc.fail: It floats; or hangs upward; or stays out stiffly.
It is rigid like a board; or stretches; or passes through the mirror.
A second mirror appears; or the cloth duplicates; or the cloth passes through the wall.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The cloth's colour and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The cloth changes colour; or the frame changes; or the room rearranges.
